segments.text: Hello and welcome to the level 3 BSL 3 laboratory, which is used for containment of pathogens
and other experiments involving high risk group biological agents.
To begin we have to check the pressure, so the pressure as you can see is positive, so
the first door which is actually the vestibule has a positive pressure to keep the air out.
So I am going to lock in, we enter the first area which is actually the urine area, over
here the pressure is positive, the positive pressure and you can see inside these are the
different suites for processing of samples.
Now this room is positive and the air in this room is basically pressurized to keep the
pathogens intact in the next room.
So the next room is basically at negative pressure, you can see it has a negative pressure of 24.2
Pascals and we have a second security procedure.
Ok now we enter into the negative pressure area, this is the negative pressure area,
we have the control rooms which control all the fans and the heating, ventilation,
cooling and air conditioning systems, we have a monitor for a CCTV for security protocols
in the control room, we go down and we have an autoclave, so basically everything which
comes out from this facility is autoclave and incinerated in accordance with the standard
operating procedure.
And we have here what is known as the pass-through box, so samples are passed to the researchers
working in the facility via the pass-through box.
So I am going to go into the next area which is the clean change room and this is where
we have another security procedure and you have another negative pressure drop.
So this is the clean change room and this is where we will be donning and doffing our
protective gear.
So this is the, we go in through this stove, all the SOPs are listed here, we follow through
with them, we have to adhere very strictly to SOPs and in turn these SOPs are tested
for performance as well.
This is, there is one way in and this is the way out, when we come out we actually
doff off here, I cannot take the camera beyond this point as that is a restricted area and
we shower out on the way out here before changing into our street clothes.
So all the taps as you can see are automated, we are not allowed to touch any surface or
minimize contact with any surface and we finally change into our street clothes on the way
out.
Okay, that is a brief tour of the facility, I will be discussing more of this facility
design concept in my forthcoming MOC course.
Thank you very much for watching and stay bio safe.
